articles.title: Gorbag Hackers Exploit WinRAR Vulnerability to Steal Credentials From Ukrainian Government Agencies
articles.summary:
Russia-aligned hackers tracked as Gorbag are exploiting a WinRAR vulnerability to steal browser credentials, VPN configurations, and sensitive documents from Ukrainian organizations. Active since at least February 2025, the group targets government agencies, law enforcement bodies, justice institutions, local administrations near the front line, and defense organizations. The campaign favors quick data theft over extended […]

articles.title: The Sandbox Fights Back: Joe Security Launches Adaptive Detonation
articles.summary:

Joe Security‘s Adaptive Detonation brings active intervention to malware analysis, helping security teams investigate threats that may conceal their behavior during an initial sandbox run. articles.title: Scammers Use Microsoft Azure to Host Fake Windows Security Alerts Seen at 80 Organizations
articles.summary:
Scammers are abusing Microsoft Azure to host fake Windows security alerts that pressure users into calling fraudulent support numbers. Between March and October 2026, the same fake Microsoft support kit reached users at 80 organizations. New landing pages were still appearing daily as of November 2, showing that the operation remained active. These figures describe […]

articles.title: Critical SolarWinds Dameware Flaw Could Allow Attackers to Compromise Remote Systems
articles.summary:
SolarWinds has warned about a critical command injection flaw in its Dameware remote support software. It is tracked as CVE-2026-28336 and carries a severity score of 9.9 out of 10. The bug could let an attacker take over a computer that an IT team is controlling remotely. Dameware is widely used by help desks and […]

articles.title: French Bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Confirms Cyberattack Amid Reports of $133 Million Theft
articles.summary:
French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa has confirmed a cyberattack that enabled fraudulent transactions, following reports linking the institution to cryptocurrency theft exceeding $133 million. The bank says the incident is contained, operations are gradually resuming, and customer assets remain unaffected. It has not confirmed the reported loss figure. The group notified regulatory and supervisory […]

articles.title: Critical Barracuda Security Flaws Could Let Hackers Bypass Authentication and Gain Root Access
articles.summary:
Barracuda has disclosed two security vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass authorization controls and gain root access to affected appliances when exploited together. The flaws affect several Barracuda security products, but exploitation requires access to a device’s administrative interface, making exposed management systems a key concern for defenders. The vulnerabilities, tracked as CVE-2026-116606 and […]

articles.title: Node.js Schedules High-Severity Security Fixes for 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x Release Lines
articles.summary:
The Node.js project has scheduled security updates for its 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x release lines on or shortly after Wednesday, November 11, 2026. The announcement gives developers and system administrators time to prepare for patches addressing HIGH-rated vulnerabilities across all three branches. Each release line will receive a fix for at least one high-severity issue. […]

articles.title: Hackers Exploit Zyxel GS1900 Zero-Day in the Wild to Hijack Network Switches
articles.summary:
A flaw in Zyxel GS1900 switches was already being used by hackers, and the patch meant to fix it did not work. Researchers at Binarly found that a public exploit hit a different bug than the one Zyxel had patched. Zyxel has now confirmed it as a new flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-107441. Zyxel published its […]

The post Hackers Exploit Zyxel GS1900 Zero-Day in the Wild to Hijack Network Switches appeared first on Cyber Security News.

articles.title: Microsoft Edge Now Automatically Blocks Malicious Websites Sending Fake Virus Alert Notifications
articles.summary:
Microsoft Edge now automatically disables notifications from websites that send users to detected scam pages, cutting off a route used to deliver fake virus warnings. The protection connects Microsoft Defender SmartScreen and Scareware blocker detections with notification permissions, helping prevent malicious sites from repeatedly drawing people back into the same scam. The change arrived with […]

The post Microsoft Edge Now Automatically Blocks Malicious Websites Sending Fake Virus Alert Notifications appeared first on Cyber Security News.

articles.title: Google Releases Major Chrome Security Update Fixing 213 Bugs, Including 7 Critical Vulnerabilities
articles.summary:
Google has released Chrome 157 for Windows, macOS, and Linux, fixing 213 security bugs, including seven rated critical. Announced on November 3, 2026, the update addresses flaws across graphics, memory handling, browser features, and access controls. Google says the stable release will reach users over the coming days and weeks. The patched versions are 157.0.8103.38 […]
